decisions.reason: The accelerator program builds on the firm's established offer and its advisory capabilities and is still featured on the home page, but as a service it sits far from the firm's core machinery and R&D knowledge, which leaves moderate drop risk.

The bio-based bitumen binder builds on the firm's established offer and its own R&D can help it learn from early results, but it is a chemical material outside the firm's core recycling machinery knowledge and shows no reported market traction beyond its own page.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's modular treatment technology, is backed by in-house R&D and a partnership with ERMAFA, and has been featured prominently in both years as a flagship launch, so the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve it.
